title: North Caucasian languages - Wikipedia
text: There are some 34 to 38 distinct North Caucasian languages. [citation needed] The Kartvelian languages, including Georgian, Zan and Svan, were once known as South Caucasian. However, they are no longer considered related to the North Caucasian languages and are classified as an independent language family.
